definitions.ask: Should same-document links with no matching heading show as (missing) as soon as the page opens?
definitions.why: The check is a pure, I/O-free lookup, so you see a broken anchor before you press it

choices.label: They show ⊘ (missing) right away, checked against the section text before any press
They look like normal links until pressed, then turn ⊘ like other dead links
